findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:383 WHY: reviewer dispatch now tells the lane to call review_run_start, but the very next finding_add/review_pass_set examples hard-code reviewRunId as B-xxx:RR-001 instead of using the returned id. Any rerun, stale-run restart, or preexisting run makes the shipped instructions produce gate-rejected REVIEW evidence, so the prompt contract is mechanically wrong. severity: high

scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:418 WHY: the new prompt-contract guard only checks that reviewer examples mention reviewRunId/review_run_start, not that they consume the returned value instead of hard-coding RR-001. That let the broken reviewer examples and dispatch prompt ship while the contract test still passed, so the registry/prompt hardening is incomplete. severity: medium

packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts:57 and packages/main/src/core/config.ts:154 [medium] `review_pass_set` is still allowed/advised in DEV, but `review_run_start` is REVIEW-only and `assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence` rejects when `currentReviewRound` is absent. That means any DEV-time reviewer pass receipt now hard-fails despite phase policy and phaseTools advertising it as supported. Fix: either remove `review_pass_set` from DEV policy/phaseTools or add an intentional DEV-compatible run model instead of exposing an impossible command path.

packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:383-385 [medium] The reviewer dispatch prompt tells the reviewer to start `review_run_start`, but the follow-up `finding_add`/`review_pass_set` examples hard-code `reviewRunId` as `${storyId}:RR-001` instead of telling the reviewer to reuse the actual returned id. On any rerun or stale-run recovery path the copied commands are wrong and will fail the new latest-run/freshness checks. Fix: instruct reviewers to capture the returned `reviewRunId` and use a placeholder such as `<reviewRunId>` in the generated commands, not `RR-001`.

packages/main/src/core/reviewer-status.ts:117-143 [medium] Invalid reviewer evidence is only attached as `detail`, while `present` stays false, `verdict` stays `pending`, and blockerCount stays 0. In session output this can surface as `0 blockers` even when a reviewer already ran but the bound run is stale/tampered, which hides the actionable failure mode behind a generic pending state. Fix: when `invalid` evidence exists for a reviewer, mark that entry as failed (or otherwise blocker-bearing) instead of pending-only so REVIEW status matches the actual gate failure reason.

packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts:742 WHY: REVIEW anti-stall still tells reviewers to run review_pass_set without reviewRunId, but review_pass_set is now REVIEW-only evidence bound to review_run_start. A reviewer following session_brief will hit a preventable gate error instead of the intended flow, so the reviewer UX is still incomplete. severity: medium

packages/main/templates/agents/koala-review-story-init.md:764, packages/main/templates/agents/koala-review-delivery.md:758, packages/main/templates/agents/koala-review-scope-plan.md:758, and packages/main/templates/agents/koala-evaluator.md:745 (plus their .claude/.Codex mirrors) still show a reviewer-facing finding_add example without reviewRunId. Current REVIEW evidence requires the fresh reviewRunId returned by review_run_start for koala-review-* lanes (packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:137; packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:383-385), so these docs still describe a command shape that does not match code behavior.
